incidents.name: WhalebitOracleManipulation
incidents.notes: Whalebit priced staking levels off the CES/USDT Algebra pool spot price, which the attacker moved with flashloaned CES to withdraw more than deposited.

sources.ref: re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. The recorded victim is the implementation contract, not the proxy: in the exploit tx it is only ever reached through 30 DELEGATECALL frames from the proxy 0x40465755eb5846d655bbcc8c186a477469f9ce36. That proxy's EIP-1967 slot holds 0x9153e149... at the incident, and its Upgraded history is 0x5a02541cb59efcc23c581f8d6599fc9810e7ea50 (block 74633620, 2025-07-31T15:36:56Z), 0xfd28a6e45402a4322fed47f883b765f03327b36e (block 76558148, 2025-09-17T11:29:20Z) and 0x9153e149... (block 76904623, 2025-09-26T00:49:43Z) - the last of those is 8 s after the implementation's own deployment at 1758847775, so measuring from either address gives the same age to within 8 seconds.

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0x9153e149b0d90dea634ed9f7df6ff71c2109b654 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x40465755eb5846d655bbcc8c186a477469f9ce36, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (16150006s -> 16149998s)
